title: More Collectables by Memontanik
description: This Project Adds More Stuff to Collect, Craft, Use and Break! It could be a fun experience with this Project!
body:
This Project adds Stuff like Pebbles, Sharpstones, Grass Ropes, literal grass,End Update, End structures, New end biomes, Builders Dimension, Ocean dimension, Civilians, Fun Creative Mode Stuff, Unobtainable Items, A Whole lot of foods, Tools, New Armors, A Whole Ecosystem, A Way to make mobs using cells or things you broke like your teeth, eye or even Skin! It feels a bit innapopiriate (idk if i said that right) to say skin and teeth and stuff,

reccomended to use JEI if you cant figure out recipes (implier recipes will come)
